rationale.consistency: Mirrors v6 idioms (authCtx, closeResponse, CheckResponse, 401/403 via httperr) but uses pointer ResponseError vs v6 value type, package name provtest in dir test, and drops v6's exported RetryInterval/MaxRetries constants despite the source-compat constraint.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers 409 find-by-name, nil archive, missing upload URL, int32 overflow, aborted/completed while polling, malformed runtime durations, PushRefID short-circuit; unknown abort reasons map to code 0 which is dubious.
rationale.scope: Delivers the whole flow, but adds a clientcfg refactor touching v6, leaves the now-dead thresholds map computation in createCloudTest, and carries unused Client.host/version and HTTPClient.logger fields.
rationale.readability: Structure is clear, but comments are verbose and repetitive, one is contradictory (claims no map[string]any round-trip while StartLocalExecution does exactly that), and server.go keeps a 'skeleton/specs' placeholder comment.
rationale.robustness: doWithRetry resets bodies, drains/closes, honours ctx; upload/notify errors are wrapped. Minor: Info-level log on every default poll interval, notify uses context.Background, notify error code 0 for unclassified errors.
rationale.maintainability: expv2 setters and config fields are a reasonable seam, but Output type-asserts *cloudv2.Output, builds a full provisioning+v6 client just for notify, and transports the run token via the JSON collectors map; provisioning Client depends on v6 internals.
